body:
## Result and exact scope

**Complete candidate, independently audited PASS within the stated model; claimed_solved at 1/5.** A deterministic O(n log^5(2n)) exact-operation algorithm computes one multiplicatively weighted center, its optimum radius, and all centers on finite nonempty connected simple unit-edge graphs promised to be median and supplied as adjacency lists. Weights are nonnegative and finite, with exact comparisons of small-integer multiples. No cube-dimension bound is needed.

The [full frozen proof](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/417ca52e83cf06b07c388d89c756cfd86473d5b0/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30006605/bundle/PROOF.md) reduces a multiplicative threshold to additive eccentricities with integer weights in [0,n−1]. It explicitly credits the Bergé–Ducoffe–Habib SODA 2025 additive oracle and Ducoffe’s ESA 2026 decision-to-optimization reduction. **No historical-priority claim is made.**

## Independent audit and limits

The [complete separate audit](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/417ca52e83cf06b07c388d89c756cfd86473d5b0/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30006605/audit/AUDIT.md), [source checks](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/417ca52e83cf06b07c388d89c756cfd86473d5b0/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30006605/audit/SOURCE_CHECKS.md), and [correction disposition](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/417ca52e83cf06b07c388d89c756cfd86473d5b0/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30006605/audit/CORRECTIONS.md) are included unchanged. No blocking gap was found. The input is promised median; no recognition algorithm, infinite-input encoding, nonunit-edge result, or continuous-center result is supplied. Rational comparisons have encoding-dependent bit costs; the operation bound is not an encoding-independent bit-complexity theorem.

The controls deliberately use a quadratic reference additive oracle, plus a separate linear tree oracle. They do **not** implement or benchmark the fast general BDH algorithm. The theorem depends on that published theorem. This is not formal verification or independent human peer review; OpenAI tools assisted preparation and review.

## Reproducibility

From the target directory:
- Run `python3 bundle/controls.py` and compare with `bundle/CONTROL_RESULTS.json`: 10,626 exact optimization cases and 145,644 full feasible-set checks.
- Run `python3 audit/independent_controls.py` and compare with `audit/INDEPENDENT_CONTROL_RESULTS.json`: 180,102 graph/profile pairs, 2,500,246 feasible-set checks, and 787,145 contraction checks.
- Verify each folder’s `SHA256SUMS` from that folder. Final-layout replays passed byte-identically.

The frozen author packet’s pending-audit wording records its earlier freeze; the separate completed audit supplies the current review disposition.

## Change scope

Built on fresh main `03c3cc4ee2502f6937185fb55d17e1143fe5b6ea`. Exactly 16 unchanged author/audit files plus the target row’s Status, Turns, and approved Findings in QUEUE.md. Every other queue byte is preserved. No source PDFs, full-source extracts, private coordination, or corpus files are uploaded. Draft only; no merge, release, or DOI creation.
